From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alyssa Moore <alyssa@vectorgrid.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VectorGrid marketplace integration: roadmap & exception asks

Hi team + Alyssa,

Following up from last week's partner intake, VectorGrid (ISV) wants to list a combined offering on cloud marketplaces that ties their SI implementation services to a Redwood Dedicated product bundle. They flagged a few items that are going to require cross-functional alignment and, potentially, an exception to our standard marketplace onboarding flow. I want to get a short roadmap sync and capture the asks so we can triage.

High level asks from VectorGrid:
- Marketplace listing that represents a Dedicated/reserved-capacity SKU (not our usual hosted API listing)
- Metered billing integration (partner expects marketplace take + their reseller share)
- Provisioning flow: automatic account-link + onboarding for Dedicated customers (they prefer an API-driven flow)
- SI co-engineering: joint onboarding support for first 3 customers (VectorGrid will ask for engineering time)
- Security/compliance: VectorGrid needs SOC2 artifacts & audit log access sample for their compliance review

Tentative impact / constraints I expect:
- Product: need to decide whether we support Dedicated as a marketplace "PrivateOffer" or we do manual provisioning initially
- Eng: API endpoints and onboarding automation likely need ~3 sprints to fully automate
- Legal/Sales: terms around revenue share / reseller discounts will need a specialized commercial attachment

Please see the attached draft "vectorgrid-marketplace-integration-spec.md" for the partner's proposed flow and an example SOW (vectorgrid-sow.pdf).

Request: can Product/Eng/Legal confirm feasibility and high-level timeline by EOD tomorrow so I can share a recommendation with VectorGrid? Also please indicate if any immediate roadblocks (security, contractual) exist.

Proposed sync: Tue 15 Mar 16:00 PT — let me know if this works.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: VectorGrid marketplace integration: roadmap & exception asks

Mina — thanks for the clear summary. Quick technical read from infra/serving side:

Short answer: we can support a Dedicated offering on a marketplace, but not via our existing automated "Marketplace onboarding" pipeline which today only creates hosted API access and billing mappings. To do what VectorGrid wants we have two viable paths:

1) Manual provisioning (fastest):
   - Operational flow where Sales/CS create tenant + Dedicated pool, then link to customer's marketplace purchase manually.
   - Pros: can ship in 2–3 weeks for initial customers; minimal infra changes.
   - Cons: operational overhead, not scalable beyond a handful of onboards.

2) PrivateOffer API work (recommended long-term):
   - Build a PrivateOffer provisioning API + marketplace billing reconciliation support (billing webhooks, entitlement mapping).
   - Rough estimate: 6–8 weeks of scoped infra + billing work (2 backend devs + 1 infra engineer).

Specific engineering unknowns / asks we need answered now:
- Does VectorGrid require single-tenant Dedicated per customer or shared pools with per-tenant isolation?
- Will VectorGrid expect us to surface metrics to their console (we have trace/latency tokens available via existing observability API)?
- Billing model: do they require us to push usage reports to their billing system or is marketplace-managed billing sufficient?

I've attached a short tech note (tech-provisioning-note.pdf) outlining the API endpoints we'd expose and the minimal webhook contract. If we go manual for GA, we should still scope the PrivateOffer work in parallel so we can automate months 2–3.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime

Thanks Mina & Jonas — appreciate the quick responses. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing Jonas' note and the spec:

- For GA we can accept manual provisioning for the first 3 customers (that aligns with our timeline). We'll need a documented manual playbook for CS handoff and a single point of contact at Redwood for provisioning.
- VectorGrid expects the Dedicated to be per-customer (tenant-isolated) with a standard set of resource sizes (small/medium/large).
- Billing: our commercial team prefers marketplace-managed billing, with Redwood reporting usage to marketplace. We'll need a revenue share addendum in the contract that defines percentages and invoicing cadence.
- Security: our compliance team wants SOC2 Type II summary + samples of audit log exports (can be redacted). We'll push our legal team to accept a 30-day delivery SLAs for those artifacts.

Attached: VectorGrid_SOW_signed.pdf (we did an internal draft, placeholder) and a filled security questionnaire (security_questionnaire_filled.xlsx).

A couple asks for Redwood to confirm:
1) Who will be the provisioning POC at Redwood?
2) If manual onboarding, can we get a guaranteed turnaround SLA for provisioning (e.g., <= 5 business days)?
3) Are there any additional fees for dedicated deployments listed on the marketplace side (we need this for customer quotes)?

If the 15 Mar sync is still on, we'd like to invite our Head of Partnerships (cc'd on partners@vectorgrid.com) as well.

Best,
Alyssa

Thanks all — consolidating action items and a proposed short plan so we have a single source of truth before the partner sync.

Proposed plan (GA -> Manual then Automate):
- Phase 0 (GA, manual): Operational manual provisioning for first 3 customers. Sales/CS will create tenant + Dedicated pool and link to marketplace purchase. SLA: provisioning <= 5 business days. Owner: CS-onboarding (Marissa). Target: complete for first customers in April.
- Phase 1 (automation): Implement PrivateOffer provisioning API + billing webhook reconciliation. Scope: 6–8 weeks, owners: Infra/Serving (Jonas) + Billing (Karthik). Target: mid-May 2027.
- Commercial: Legal to draft a revenue-share addendum and reseller discount schedule. Owner: Legal/Sales. Target: draft by 2027-03-19.
- Security/Compliance: Security to provide SOC2 Type II summary and a redacted audit-log sample. Owner: security@redwood.ai. Target: 2027-03-22.

Action owners & immediate asks (owners — pls reply inline if dates don't work):
- Marissa (CS): confirm we can meet 5 business day provisioning SLA and document the manual playbook by 2027-03-18.
- Jonas (Eng): confirm the 6–8 week estimate and whether we can scope a minimal API for provisioning webhooks within that window.
- Karthik (Billing): confirm marketplace billing model compatibility and whether we need marketplace-specific SKU changes.
- Legal: prepare revenue-share addendum draft by 2027-03-19.
- Security: confirm deliverables and target date (2027-03-22).

I've filed a JIRA for the automation work: INT-1284 and attached the partner spec + tech note. Please ack receipt and any immediate issues. If nobody objects, I'll confirm the 15 Mar 16:00 PT sync with VectorGrid and invite Legal and Security to attend.

Mina
